fields.name: sku
fields.description: Product SKU (Ozon SKU, e.g., 175924376). This is the sku returned by other Nexscope Ozon tools

fields.name: dateRange
fields.description: Sales/metrics statistics window, default past_30_days. Options: past_7_days / past_30_days / past_60_days / past_90_days / past_180_days / past_365_days

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Member ID (a unique member identifier; a user can belong to multiple teams; data is attributed to memberId, max 1000)
